text.description_html:
Weslock 6691/6202, Double Cylinder Woodward II Handleset

The design of this Weslock made handleset features square mounts. The simple yet classic beauty of the Woodward II Double Cylinder Weslock Handleset makes it a good choice for those who want to add a touch of quiet embellishment to their doors. It is available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Easy to install, the contemporary Woodward II Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Double cylinder entry sets are most often used on doors located near a window. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is key operated from both the interior and the exterior while the latch underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob/lever from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Woodward II Single Cylinder Handleset
Woodward II Dummy Handleset

This modern styled lever is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Woodward II Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Material: solid brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with 2-1/8" top (1-5/8" optional) and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Weslock Elegance Collection Woodward II Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 18-3/4"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/8"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
